items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: The interviewee does not respond to the interviewer's mention of Johnny Lolliver, nor does the interviewee mention him in their own turn. The only information provided is from the interviewer stating 'I heard of him.'

ctx.x: Who was that white boy that he used to talk about down in the world? And Emmett Hardy. Yeah, that's who Bidebeck I think used to try to play like. Emmett Hardy. Yeah. Did you ever see Emmett Hardy?

No, I never did. There was another guy called Johnny Lolliver. Nobody knew nothing about him. He was a hell of a trumpet player. I heard of him. There was nobody. There was nobody. Did you know? Somebody played a whole lot of horn. He was running to go to Richard Times and his daddy owned a half of French Mophage. Hey George.
Hello, Bud D. Well, it was last week, man.
